latest_validated_core_feature_head.message: Test visual failure taxonomy through truth gate report
latest_validated_core_feature_head.functional_increment: Read-only visual truth failures are now classified by the first failed existing gate and propagated through the shadow receipt ledger into the independent gate report. A reachable public article with zero occurrences of the approved image is classified SITE_APPROVED_VISUAL_ABSENT / SITE_CONTENT instead of being conflated with provenance or transport failure. Existing PASS/FAIL delivery semantics and visual identity thresholds are unchanged.
